thread:
maya: Customer cs-8432 hitting ValidationError in our SDK when using JSON mode. They say price becomes null and pydantic fails because schema requires number.

support-bot: ticket #CS-2024-983 created: https://app.helpdesk.example/ticket/CS-2024-983 - auto-attached request_id=rz-9f4b

sam: Can you paste minimal repro (request payload + model config + returned output)?

maya: repro steps below. model call uses json_mode:true, schema attached. temperature=0.6, streaming=false.

```json
// request payload (redacted)
{
  "request_id": "rz-9f4b",
  "model": "open-encoder-v1",
  "json_mode": true,
  "schema": {
    "type": "object",
    "properties": {
      "items": { "type": "array", "items": { "type": "object", "properties": { "price": { "type": "number" } }, "required": ["price"] } }
    },
    "required": ["items"]
  }
}
```

```json
// model returned (truncated)
{
  "items": [
    { "id": "sku-123", "price": null },
    { "id": "sku-456", "price": 12.5 }
  ]
}
```

maya: pydantic error message: ValidationError: value is not a valid float (type=type_error.float) at items -> 0 -> price

ian: quick workaround: in the client's pydantic model make price: Optional[float] or use parse_obj with allow_none conversion, or coerce null->0 in a pre-validate step. Also check temperature — 0.6 can produce hallucinated nulls.

sam: Does the customer always get null for that field or only sometimes?

maya: intermittent across ~15% of calls. customer says it started after they increased batch_size and turned on prefix caching.

ian: that hints at KV cache / batching truncation or tokenization edge-case where the model emits `null` token sequence. Could also be streaming buffer boundary. Two actions: 1) ask customer to test with temperature=0 and batching=1 to see if deterministic; 2) we can add a JSON post-process that fixes null numeric fields when schema says number.

sam: agreed. can you get request_id examples and raw API logs? I'll triage.

maya: attached two raw logs in the ticket (logs show full response body for rz-9f4b and rz-9f8c). sharing snippet: response body contains `...\"price\": null,
  \"price\": 12.5` in different items.

sam: thanks. I'm going to try repro locally with same model + config. if I can reproduce consistently i'll escalate to eng-runtime/eng-ml. tagging @ian for runtime investigation.

ian: if you can repro, please include: model name, exact request payload, headers (esp. content-length if chunked), and the SDK version. also try toggling `json_mode_strict` (if used) and streaming toggles. I suspect a kernel-level tokenization split or a micro-serialization bug.

maya: SDK v2.4.1, model open-encoder-v1, client sent `Accept: application/json` and we used default chunking. I'll run local repro now and report back in this thread.

sam: short-term customer guidance: 1) set temperature=0; 2) set batch_size=1; 3) as workaround enable local post-validate step to coerce null->0 for numeric schema fields; 4) we'll follow up with a runtime patch if reproducible.

maya: ok relayed to customer. they asked whether we can supply a helper util. can we add a small JSON sanitizer example to the SDK?

ian: yes, I'll open a small PR with a sanitize_numeric_nulls util and an example in the SDK repo. if eng-runtime finds a bug we'll coordinate a fix.

sam: creating internal issue INF-4721 and adding eng-runtime + eng-ml. linking ticket CS-2024-983.

maya: thanks all. I'll update customer. :thumbsup:
